item.title: Hackerpulse Episode - October 15, 2025: Press Access, Dark Matter Discovery, and the Literacy Crisis
item.description: In this episode of Hackerpulse, we explore significant stories making waves in the tech and media sectors. From the Pentagon's controversial new press-access policies raising First Amendment concerns to groundbreaking research imaging a dark matter clump, we cover it all. We also touch on alarming literacy declines in U.S. schools and the emerging role of AI in educational contexts. Tune in for a concise summary of today’s impactful discussions!

item.title: Hackerpulse Episode - October 16, 2025: AI Advancements and E-Commerce Insights
item.description: In this episode of Hackerpulse, we cover the latest tech highlights including Apple's groundbreaking M5 chip launch, the rise of AI in coding with Claude Haiku 4.5, and a shocking discovery of bots skewing e-commerce metrics. We also explore Ireland's permanent basic income program for artists and a new Android attack class named Pixnapping. Tune in for succinct insights and the stories shaping the tech landscape today!

item.title: October 14, 2025: Media Stands Against New Pentagon Press Rules
item.description: In this episode of Hackerpulse, we discuss the significant pushback from major media outlets against the Department of Defense’s new press-access rules. These policies threaten to limit journalists' access and oversight of military operations, raising concerns about First Amendment rights and the free flow of information. Tune in for a breakdown of this developing story and its implications for journalism and democracy.
